title: "Traffic Accident Severity"
---

## Project

An educational presentation about traffic-risk management in Vietnam, supported by an interactive machine-learning demonstration.

This GitHub Pages site contains static documentation. The interactive Python application runs separately on Streamlit Community Cloud.

## Use the project

- [Source repository](https://github.com/nhamhung/traffic-accident-severity)
- [Interactive Streamlit app](https://traffic-accident-severity-cvz7oug8kg8mbftwnn8e6r.streamlit.app/)
- [Clone, fork, and deployment guide](https://github.com/nhamhung/traffic-accident-severity/blob/main/docs/SETUP_AND_DEPLOYMENT.md)

## Reproduce it

Clone the repository, create a Python 3.11 or 3.12 environment, install `requirements.txt` and `app/requirements.txt`, run `pytest tests/`, then run `python scripts/smoke_app.py`.

Open Dự đoán, Dữ liệu nói gì?, Chuẩn bị dữ liệu and Ứng dụng vào quản lý; load a real accident and read its prediction and explanation.
